notes.title: NEW: Map editor & full Steam workshop support
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35265650/6c389babb3b78e783896f1aa52c41c5d9e0546d5.jpg[/img]
[h1]Map editor & Steam Workshop support added![/h1]
I am very happy to announce that I've added a map editor aswel as Steam workshop support to the game. Get creative and create your own maps, and easily share them with the community so everyone can play your maps!

[b]Map editor[/b]
With the new map editor you can easily create your own levels! You can create small and big levels (128x128 meters and 256x256 meters). You'll have to prove you can complete the level before being able to save level and share it with the community!

You can acces the map editor via the main menu --> Sandbox --> Create map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35265650/1e921899eaf8892255e014419b7d25669a9593a8.jpg[/img]

[b]Steam workshop support[/b]
Using the map editor you can now also upload your level to Steam workshop, so other players can play your newly created levels!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35265650/bd8f499fb214b02a3226654a1fe0fdaf4af5103e.png[/img]

[b]Graphics update[/b]
There's also a new graphics update with the map editor update! Added bloom, reflection and ambient occlusion. Go jump in the game to see the difference yourself ;-).

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35265650/d616a4805697f51a8ff28b0b879e846b2d1c7377.jpg[/img]
[h1]Spooky Halloween Update![/h1]
Happy Halloween everyone. To celebrate I've released a new major update with a brand new game mode, 16 new levels and some new achievements!

[previewyoutube=EGM9f9p-CXM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]New Spooky game mode: Trick or Treat![/b]
A new game mode has been added to the game, together with 16 brand new spooky levels. You still have to build a bridge like usual, however, this time you need to pick up the pumpkins before finishing the track.

This could mean that you're unable to go via the cheapest route, so get creative on your new bridges!

[b]New Achievements[/b]
In addition to the new game mode, I've also implemented a few extra Halloween achievements!

[b]Discord[/b]
In the new update I have included a new Discord invite link (seen in the main menu from the game). Everyone is welcome to join to share their awesome creations and talk about the game.

If you'd like to join already, here's the link: [url=https://discord.gg/tWFsj9p]https://discord.gg/tWFsj9p[/url]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
I've also fixed a few bugs thanks to some of my new beta testers!

Happy halloween everyone!


Xitech

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35265650/3ba9a0c1f8d0936ed83faefceca979b89665a693.jpg[/img]
[h1]Patch 1.2.1[/h1]
After more monitoring of the game, I saw that some people were having difficulties starting with the game when they've never played a Bridge Builder game. I have added a tutorial for the first level, and a few bugfixes.

[b]Tutorial[/b]
The first level has been re-designed into a tutorial level. You will be forced to play this little tutorial. After the tutorial, you can play level 1 as usual. Optionally you can re-do the tutorial by clicking on the tutorial button in level 1.

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
Again a few bugs have been reported, thanks everyone for reporting! On some levels the camera started in the wrong position so players had no clue where the car was. On some rare occasions the camera went into the level/hill. This has been fixed.

Keep on playing everyone and if you have a suggestion you can contact me or add it to the Steam discussion.

Kind Regards,

Xitech

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35265650/005034e74183c34d9c59408b7372df5c5cf43e77.jpg[/img]
[h1]Patch 1.1.1[/h1]
I have monitored the game and worked on another new level for the hard difficulty. Also some people have reported some bugs, thank you!

[b]New Level[/b]
I've added a new level, level 48 to the game. This is the last level for the hard difficulty. There are definitely plans to make another difficulty as more players are progressing towards the hard difficulty. Well done to everyone reaching the hard difficulty already! Can you finish this level with a 3 star rating already ;-)?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35265650/110da13519622d12327a0098e689d2001cb17307.png[/img]

[b]Twitch stream support[/b]
To support both small and big streamers, I have now implemented the twitch API to display a streamer from Twitch in the main menu of the game. The button will redirect you to their stream.

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
Some people have reported some bugs to me (thank you!). The ending platforms collision was not always right and there was a possibility that the money preview or road preview would be still be visible even while in race mode. This has now been fixed!

[b]Credits list[/b]
Even though I have solo developed this game, I definitely could not have done this without the help of various people and beta testers. To honor them, I have added a list of people who helped me out, thanks again everyone :).

Keep on playing everyone and if you have a suggestion you can contact me or add it to the Steam discussion.

Kind Regards,

Xitech

notes.title: Bridge Builder Racer Hotfix & Tiny update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35265650/d5b164296145b0c681de067a02c59c734f400df1.jpg[/img]
[h1]Bridge Builder Racer V1.0.1[/h1]
It is already time to bring in a little update to the game. I have had a few feature requests and someone pointed me out to a bug leading you were not able to quite the game properly.

[b]Tiny update 1.0.1[/b]
In this update I have added the functionality to use the space bar at all times to switch between build and drive mode. No more need to use the mouse for that!

I have also added the ability to browse through the highscores, so now you can see all scores after you've finished the level.

[b]Hotfix[/b]
It was already time for my first hotfix of the game ;-). I have fixed an issue that the escape button did not work properly in the main menu. You are now able to exit the game properly.

Enjoy the new update, and keep on playing. If you yourself have any feature request please do let me know via the Steam discussions or contact me on Steam.

Cheers,


Xitech

notes.title: Bridge Builder Racer Release!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35265650/d66a485fee1c39d99b9d079961ae7ab58d28df1e.jpg[/img]
[h1]Bridge Builder Racer Version 1.0[/h1]
Version 1.0 of my first game Bridge Builder Racer has been released.

[b]What now?[/b]
My focus for the first few days will be listening to the community, and making sure everyone is able to play the game. I'm also keeping a close eye on the game itself and to add tiny fixes and improvements. I am also open to any suggestions you may have. For now: Enjoy the game!

Kind regards!

notes.title: Less than a week to go! DevLog update.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35265650/8ef54a999b19785245870919f99eaa73a53c7fe9.jpg[/img]
[h1]The first announcement[/h1]
[b]First things first:[/b]
I've been solo-developing this game for over a year now, and I cannot wait to release the game to the public. I am open to any suggestions from the community :)!

Launching my first title is extremely stressful, but a lot of fun! Thanks to all of my beta testers so far to test my levels. There are simply too many levels to test it all myself. And somehow, some of the testers beat me in my own game.

[b]What's new[/b]
I've been working hard to have a more smooth experience within the game itself. So i've implemented the following:
[list]
[*] New UI
[*] Smooth camera controls
[*] CTRL+ Z functionality
[*] Steam cloud
[/list]

[b]What's next[/b]
Before launching the game I am fixing a few tiny bugs, a few more levels, some more achievements and possibly an auto save function for your bridges.

Cheers!
